name: Outlook on the web
note: "Outlook on the web" tab only (the New Outlook and Classic Outlook desktop tabs on this same page are already covered by catalog/outlook.json). That tab's shortcuts refer to the 'Outlook' keyboard-shortcut scheme within Outlook on the web/Outlook.com (the page notes you can instead opt into Outlook.com-, Yahoo Mail-, or Gmail-style shortcuts under Settings > General > Accessibility; those alternate schemes are not covered here) and are presented as a single list with no separate macOS column, so only `windows` is populated per action and it applies across desktop browsers/OSes as documented. Where the article lists two equivalent bindings for one action (e.g. 'Ctrl+Shift+F or Shift+F'), the first-listed binding is used here. Section headings from the article ('Message and reading list', 'Message list', 'Reading list', 'Calendar', 'Calendar forms', 'People') are used as `context` since they describe distinct panes/modes, not just headings. The article's own 'Go to the calendar' (Ctrl+Shift+2) row is repeated verbatim under both Frequently used and Calendar in the source and is listed once here. Omitted because the grammar cannot express them, are undocumented ('No shortcut'), or are mouse/pointer-only: the accent-mark and special-character Alt-numpad tables, 'Switch view to include today', 'Navigate to the previous/next pane', a second 'Move to a different region' row, 'Switch to three-day view', and 'List view'.
